summary: Targeted verification of the 8 fixes from iteration_7 (7 frontend regressions + 1 backend minor). Backend: 8/8 pytest assertions pass (email + username login for owner/co-owner/tester with correct roles; /api/school/me now 200 with {school:null,classes:[]} for owner and full school payload for tester, no _id leakage). Frontend (owner Yusufm_1 + tester): no 'Compiled with problems' overlay, zero console errors, all 16 expected sidebar testids present, no 'Parents Evening'/'Recordings', sn-dreams hidden for owner and shown for tester, side-nav-logout works (logs out, side-nav gone), a11y-open present (2 instances: desktop header + mobile footer) and panel opens/closes via a11y-close, Practice cards resolve to real topic pages (algebra/grammar/cells, no 'Topic not found'), Reports Autumn 2025 triggers a real file download (Term-1-progress-report.txt) and future report shows the 'not published yet' toast, /teacher renders teacher-page for owner. ONE REGRESSION IS NOT FIXED: for school users (tester) the Classes sub-links still dead-end on 'Subject not found.'

ui_bugs.issue: Panel does not close on Escape key (only the X button / backdrop works). WCAG 2.2 dialog expectation + no keyboard trap handling.
handleLogout navigates to '/' but the app lands on /login (guard redirect). Functionally fine, but differs from the stated spec — confirm intended landing page.

integration_issues.flow: SideNav Classes sub-links for SCHOOL users (regression #4 NOT fixed)
integration_issues.issue: For tester@tester.org (school_tester_demo) /api/school/me returns 8 classes with NO subject_id, so SideNav falls back to `c.name.toLowerCase()` producing ids like '7a','7b','8a'... Links go to /subjects/7a which renders 'Subject not found.' The fallback only kicks in when the class list is EMPTY, not when class ids are not real curriculum subject ids. Fix: validate each mapped id against SUBJECTS in /app/frontend/src/lib/subjects.js and drop/replace invalid ones (or route class links to a real class page instead of /subjects/:id).

action_items: SideNav.jsx: filter school class sub-links through the real subjects.js id list (fallback per-item, not only when list is empty) so /subjects/7a style dead links never render.
Optional: add Escape-to-close (and focus trap) to AccessibilityMenu.
critical_code_review_comments: SideNav.jsx line ~136-143: the comment claims classes are validated against curriculum subjects but no validation exists — only an emptiness check. This is the cause of the remaining dead sub-links.
Reports.jsx download is a client-side .txt stub, not a PDF; button label says 'Download report' — acceptable placeholder but flag for product.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration_8 verified 7 of 8 fixes. Only remaining item: school-user Classes sub-links (/subjects/<classname>) render 'Subject not found.'. Backend regression suite: /app/backend/tests/test_iter8_regressions.py (note: /api/auth/login_username expects body key 'identifier', not 'username'). No DPA gate appeared for any of the three accounts during this run.
rca_of_the_issue: Classes sub-links: /api/school/me class docs for school_tester_demo have subject/name fields but no subject_id, so SideNav maps id to name.toLowerCase() ('7a'). Subject page looks up id in subjects.js, finds nothing, and renders 'Subject not found.' The FALLBACK_CLASSES guard only triggers when the class list is empty.
